subject: Kerala Geography
textEn: Which river of Kerala is called "Dakshina Bhageerathi"?
explanation: The Pampa, on whose bank the Sabarimala temple stands, is called Dakshina Bhageerathi.

subject: Kerala Geography
textEn: What is another name of the Bharathapuzha?
explanation: The Bharathapuzha is also known as the Nila.

subject: Kerala Geography
textMl: കേരളത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും നീളം കൂടിയ രണ്ടാമത്തെ നദി ഏതാണ്?
textEn: Which is the second longest river in Kerala?
explanation: The Periyar is the longest; the Bharathapuzha (about 209 km) is the second longest.

subject: Kerala Geography
textMl: കേരളത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും നീളം കുറഞ്ഞ നദി ഏതാണ്?
textEn: Which is the shortest river in Kerala?
explanation: The Manjeswaram river, about 16 km long, is the shortest river in Kerala.

subject: Kerala Geography
textEn: On which river are the Athirappilly Falls?
explanation: The Athirappilly Falls are on the Chalakudy river.

subject: Kerala Geography
textEn: Which of these rivers of Kerala flows east?
explanation: The Kabani is one of the three east-flowing rivers of Kerala; it joins the Kaveri.

subject: Kerala Geography
textMl: ഇടുക്കി ആർച്ച് ഡാം ഏത് നദിക്ക് കുറുകെയാണ് നിർമ്മിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്?
textEn: The Idukki Arch Dam is built across which river?
explanation: The Idukki Arch Dam is built across the Periyar.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textMl: ശ്രീനാരായണ ഗുരു അരുവിപ്പുറത്ത് ശിവപ്രതിഷ്ഠ നടത്തിയ വർഷം ഏതാണ്?
textEn: In which year did Sree Narayana Guru consecrate the Shiva idol at Aruvippuram?
explanation: Sree Narayana Guru consecrated the idol at Aruvippuram in 1888.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: Who founded the Samathwa Samajam?
explanation: Vaikunda Swamikal founded the Samathwa Samajam in 1836.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textMl: അയ്യങ്കാളി വില്ലുവണ്ടി യാത്ര നടത്തിയ വർഷം ഏതാണ്?
textEn: In which year did Ayyankali make his Villuvandi journey?
explanation: Ayyankali rode a bullock cart (villuvandi) through public roads in 1893 to assert the right of all to use them.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: Who founded the Atmavidya Sangham?
explanation: Vagbhatananda founded the Atmavidya Sangham in 1917.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: In which year was the Ezhava Memorial submitted?
explanation: The Ezhava Memorial was submitted to the Maharaja of Travancore in 1896.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textMl: "അടുക്കളയിൽ നിന്ന് അരങ്ങത്തേക്ക്" എന്ന നാടകം എഴുതിയത് ആരാണ്?
textEn: Who wrote the play "Adukkalayil Ninnu Arangathekku"?
explanation: V. T. Bhattathiripad wrote the play in 1948; it called for reform among Namboothiri women.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textMl: "ഒരു ജാതി, ഒരു മതം, ഒരു ദൈവം മനുഷ്യന്" എന്ന സന്ദേശം ആരുടേതാണ്?
textEn: Whose message is "One caste, one religion, one God for mankind"?
explanation: This is the best-known message of Sree Narayana Guru.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: Who led the Guruvayur Satyagraha?
explanation: K. Kelappan led the Guruvayur Satyagraha of 1931-32.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textMl: വൈക്കം സത്യാഗ്രഹത്തിന് പിന്തുണയുമായി 1925-ൽ വൈക്കം സന്ദർശിച്ച ദേശീയ നേതാവ് ആരാണ്?
textEn: Which national leader visited Vaikom in 1925 in support of the Vaikom Satyagraha?
explanation: Mahatma Gandhi visited Vaikom in March 1925.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: In which year did the Vaikom Satyagraha end?
explanation: The Vaikom Satyagraha began in 1924 and was called off in 1925.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textMl: കേരളത്തിൽ ഉപ്പുസത്യാഗ്രഹം നടന്ന പ്രധാന സ്ഥലം ഏതാണ്?
textEn: Where was the main Salt Satyagraha held in Kerala?
explanation: The Salt Satyagraha of 1930 in Kerala was held at Payyannur.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textMl: തിരുവിതാംകൂറിൽ ക്ഷേത്രപ്രവേശന വിളംബരം പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ച രാജാവ് ആരാണ്?
textEn: Which ruler issued the Temple Entry Proclamation in Travancore?
explanation: Sree Chithira Thirunal Balarama Varma issued the proclamation in 1936.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: What was the main demand of the Vaikom Satyagraha?
optionA: Public roads near the temple open to all castes
explanation: The satyagraha demanded that all castes be allowed to use the roads around the Vaikom temple.

subject: Kerala Renaissance
textEn: On which date was the Temple Entry Proclamation issued?
explanation: The proclamation was issued on 12 November 1936.

subject: Indian History
textMl: "ചെയ്യുക അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മരിക്കുക" ("Do or Die") എന്ന മുദ്രാവാക്യം ആരുടേതാണ്?
textEn: Who gave the slogan "Do or Die"?
explanation: Gandhi gave the call "Do or Die" at the start of the Quit India Movement.

subject: Indian History
textMl: ക്വിറ്റ് ഇന്ത്യ സമരം ആരംഭിച്ച വർഷം ഏതാണ്?
textEn: In which year did the Quit India Movement begin?
explanation: The Quit India Movement began in August 1942.

subject: Indian History
textEn: Who said "Swaraj is my birthright"?
explanation: Bal Gangadhar Tilak gave this slogan.

subject: Indian History
textEn: In which year did the Non-Cooperation Movement begin?
explanation: Gandhi launched the Non-Cooperation Movement in 1920.

subject: Indian History
textMl: ചൗരി ചൗര സംഭവം നടന്ന വർഷം ഏതാണ്?
textEn: In which year did the Chauri Chaura incident take place?
explanation: The Chauri Chaura incident took place in 1922 and led Gandhi to withdraw the Non-Cooperation Movement.

subject: Indian History
textEn: In which year did the Partition of Bengal take place?
explanation: Lord Curzon partitioned Bengal in 1905.
